svg.title: Three-view anatomical atlas style muscular male muscle and joint map
svg.desc: Front, rear, and side full-body muscular male in a grayscale anatomical-atlas style. Every supplied muscle and joint remains a canonical SVG group whose id equals its slug.
svg.metadata: Canonical selection contract: document.getElementById(slug). Each canonical group has data-slug and data-type. Child geometry carries data-view=front|rear|side.

g.text: DOM contract: #<slug> → canonical group; hover highlights; child geometry has data-view.
